## Conocimiento pendiente de promoción (a wiki)
- Flor is mandatory to sing if the player has it and the rival hasn't sung yet (confirmed via truco game source)
- Flor + Flor resolves to 6 points (3+3) before further escalation to Contraflor/Contraflor al Resto
- Canto UI convention: button text may abbreviate (RETRUCO / VALE CUATRO) but the displayed canto must keep QUIERO prefix
